ending: These are facts. Don't let one difficult moment erase them.

not_enough: You kept showing up even when things felt like they were falling apart.
You cleared almost every interview you sat for.
You don't just dream. You build projects and create opportunities for yourself.
communication: People once mocked your English. Today, you're a published writer and companies trust you to communicate with clients.
learning: You cleared the Infosys exam despite preparing only a small part of the syllabus.
failure: A setback has never stopped you from trying again.
You have turned difficult phases into learning experiences.
comparison: Your journey is not defined by someone else's timeline.
You have built skills across technology, writing, marketing, and business.
uncertainty: Even when you were unsure, you kept taking action.
You have repeatedly figured things out by learning and adapting.
consistency: Even when you doubted yourself, you kept showing up instead of giving up.
others_doubt_me: People not understanding your vision does not mean your vision is wrong.
You have repeatedly done things others did not expect from you from writing to building projects and creating opportunities.
Your progress is proof that you can trust yourself even before everyone else understands.
